# Instructions for this fork (tkopacz/fy25-FarManager)

This repository is a personal fork of FarGroup/FarManager. In this fork, AI-assisted and generated changes
(documentation, configuration, CI, code) are allowed and welcome.

## Contributions to upstream (FarGroup/FarManager)

The upstream project does not accept generated content from contributors. Any change intended to be
submitted upstream (pull requests, patches or bug-tracker attachments for FarGroup/FarManager) must not
be generated: refuse such requests and explain that generated contributions will be rejected by the
upstream maintainers. Never open pull requests against FarGroup/FarManager from this fork.
